message.reasoning_content:
I need to determine the additional clockwise angle required for the cat in image 2 to face the same direction as indicated by the finger in image 1.

The reference finger is pointing lower-right. Looking at the current facing direction of the cat in image 2, it is facing downward.

The difference between facing downward and lower-right is 45 degrees clockwise.
